sm_top.sm: Bahrain stated it intercepted six drones launched by Iran's IRGC targeting a US radar.
Oil tankers caught fire after striking sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
An Israeli airstrike on Nasser Hospital in Gaza killed 6 people, drawing international condemnation.
An Israeli strike killed senior Hamas commander Samir Abu Younis in Gaza.
An oil tanker caught fire after striking a mine east of the Strait of Hormuz.
The UAE strongly condemns a fresh Iranian drone attack on Bahrain.
Russian air defenses intercepted multiple Ukrainian drones overnight across various regions and sites, while a strike killed one person in Taganrog.
Coalition forces intercepted multiple Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh and drones over eastern Saudi Arabia.
Yemeni government forces retreated from the Bab el-Mandab area as Houthi forces advanced.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted ballistic missiles and drones targeting Riyadh and other areas in Saudi Arabia.
The IRGC claims to have shot down a US drone over Qeshm Island.
Houthi forces launched ballistic missiles at Yemeni government military staging areas and command centers in Aden and Lahij governorates.
Saudi air defenses intercepted ballistic missiles and drones targeting Riyadh, Mecca, and Medina.
Estonian military provided details regarding a Ukrainian drone strike on a Russian missile ship in the Gulf of Finland.
Ukrainian strikes hit the Akhtubinsk airfield and a drone launch site in Russia, leaving a runway on fire.
Ukraine struck the Samara Urals oil hub and the Lipetsk-2 airbase.
Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia damaged a residential building and an educational institution, injuring 15 people.
A third US aircraft carrier is heading to the Middle East amid rising tensions.
Saudi air defenses destroyed ballistic missiles and drones targeting Riyadh.
Taiwan reported that China mobilized more than 100 ships near Taiwan during maneuvers.
Russian attacks across Ukraine killed nine people, injured 61, and caused a fire at a Kyiv hospital.
An airstrike on a displacement camp in Myanmar killed 12 people.
Russia launched 96 strike drones at Ukraine, with Ukrainian air defenses intercepting 81, most shot down by F‑16 fighters.
Ukraine launched a large wave of nearly 1,200 drones at Russia.
Fighting and mechanized assaults continue around Dobropillia as Ukrainian forces conduct counterattacks against Russian positions.
Russia launched 132 attack drones at Ukraine, with 106 intercepted and hits recorded at 20 locations, killing 4 and injuring 69.
Ukrainian forces struck oil refining units at the LUKOIL-Volgogradneftepererabotka refinery in Volgograd.
Russian forces attacked an energy facility in the Odesa region, leaving nearly 50,000 consumers without power.
Russian Defence Ministry claimed a strike hit port infrastructure and a dry cargo ship in Chornomorsk port.
Russia launched a mass attack on Odesa Oblast as Ukraine struck an airfield and drone launch site in Russia.
Dozens are reported injured by shelling in Zaporizhzhia during Russian attacks across Ukraine.
The Houthis claim that the Saudi-led coalition carried out airstrikes across Yemen over a 24-hour period.
Anadolu reported that Israel has carried out 793 attacks on health services in Gaza since October 2023, resulting in 1,725 health worker deaths.
An analysis of leaked data indicates around 300 Russian citizens, likely Wagner and Africa Corps mercenaries, have been killed in Mali.
Houthi forces operationally encircled thousands of PLC/STC soldiers in Lahij Governorate, advancing across a wide front.
President Zelenskiy stated that Russian forces struck energy infrastructure in five regions and railway infrastructure in three regions overnight.
Clashes between the Rizeigat and Habbaniya tribes in Western Sudan left 50 dead and dozens wounded.
Ukraine's General Staff reported 171 combat clashes and 311 Russian aerial bomb drops over the past day.
An Australian doctor described devastation at a Gaza hospital following an Israeli strike.
Yemeni government forces launch a massive offensive against the Houthis, claiming 723 strikes and numerous casualties.
